pr_title: expression: fix wrong result when convert float to unsigned (#53590)
pr_body:
This is an automated cherry-pick of #53590

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #41736

Problem Summary:
1. When compare `int column` with `non int constant`, will convert `non int constant` to int
2. [This logic](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/e6d1899492f1241926fb8baa411a7146effabf94/pkg/expression/builtin_compare.go#L1613) is used to check if underflow happens when convert to int, which requires we should set result as zero when convert X to unsigned int
3. But [ConvertFloatToUint](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/e6d1899492f1241926fb8baa411a7146effabf94/pkg/types/convert.go#L172) will not obey this requirement when `AllowNegativeToUnsigned` is disabled.

PS: what does `AllowNegativeToUnsigned` mean, check description [here](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/57d0b40cd9610351a6769926e5c9e30ddd5f6b7c/pkg/executor/executor.go#L2008)

### What changed and how does it work?
Disable `AllowNegativeToUnsigned` when conversion happens when compare `int column` with `non int constant`.

issue_context.title: An incorrect query result
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```SQL
CREATE TABLE t0(c0 tinyint(1) unsigned not null );
INSERT INTO t0 VALUES (1);
SELECT * FROM t0 WHERE CASE 0 WHEN (t0.c0)>(-1.194192591E9) THEN null ELSE 1 END; -- actual: {}, expected: {1}
```
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
The query result should be {1}.
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
The query result is an empty set.
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
